oracle.name: JAMGONG ORACLE™
oracle.desc: A high-precision predictive engine trained on historical, mathematical, astronomical, and statistical big data. It is a strategic decision-making reference engine based on traditional classical forecasting and astronomical data.

neutralsync.name: JAMGONG NEURALSYNC™
neutralsync.desc: An intelligent engine that analyzes and predicts multi-source time-series data in real-time based on meta-learning in dynamically changing environments. It integrates temporal, environmental, status, and contextual data through cross-modal attention, providing prediction uncertainties alongside explanations.
neutralsync.signature: ★ Based on intelligent system algorithm architecture for time-series pattern analysis and prediction in dynamic environments

synergy.name: JAMGONGTALK™
synergy.desc: An AI engine that parses dog behavior description texts into semantic, emotional, and contextual channels. It synthesizes breed-specific adaptive weights with non-additive synergy of behavioral symbol pairs to estimate emotional states, operating purely on text inputs without cameras or wearables.
synergy.spec3: Non-additive Synergy Inference of Symbol Pairs

holo.name: JAMGONG HOLO™
holo.descHighlight: The moment eyes meet in mid-air, a new conversation begins.
holo.descMain: A next-generation immersive AI engine where a 3D character projected in the air detects the user's gaze and emotions in real-time to create natural interactions.
holo.descSub: It is realized through JAMGONG's unique fusion of optics and AI, linking physical space and digital existence.
